summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by NewcelX Ltd. reporting the results of its Annual General Shareholders Meeting held on June 30, 2026. The filing states that shareholders approved each proposal described in the Notice and Invitation previously furnished on June 5, 2026. No specific proposals, vote tallies, or material terms are disclosed in the excerpt. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. This is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer, analogous to an 8-K filing of a domestic company.
